anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the report view apply when the user switches workspaces?
A) Clear all filters: every switch opens the new workspace's report unfiltered.
B) Preserve all filters: active filters carry over unchanged, matching what the workspace-change handler does today.
C) Restore per-workspace filters: each workspace reopens with the filters it last had, which needs per-workspace filter state stored alongside the resolved setting.
Recommendation: A - filters set in one workspace often refer to data that doesn't exist in another, and clearing avoids that without new per-workspace state beside the resolver at settings/resolver.ts:12.
